capabilities.limits: Sourced bounded helpers; consult advanced-mechanics.md for volleys. Fractional-Build vehicles and source-specific exceptions remain source-dependent.

capabilities.name: D&D SRD 5.2.1 core
capabilities.limits: Core table procedures, Fighter build and advancement examples, ledger replay. Does not include non-SRD books.

capabilities.name: SRD classes and spells
capabilities.limits: Source-bound reader covers 12 class ranges and 339 spell entries when the verified PDF is available. Multiclass slots, fixed HP and Counterspell helpers; not every class/spell interaction.

capabilities.name: Trail of Cthulhu
capabilities.limits: Creation, pools and investigation procedures; source-specific safe-rest and psychotherapy helpers in corpus-adapters.md. No full campaign certification.

capabilities.name: City of Mist v0.75 quickstart
capabilities.limits: Quickstart moves, tags and statuses; full theme questionnaires and long-term advancement are outside this source.

capabilities.name: Fate Condensed
capabilities.limits: Creation, actions and aspects; bounded consequence absorption/recovery helpers. No exhaustive stunt or campaign validation.

capabilities.name: Blades in the Dark
capabilities.limits: Core actions/resistance and bounded vice/downtime helpers. Full crew, trauma and flashback interactions remain uncovered.

capabilities.name: Local homebrew adapters
capabilities.limits: Edition-bound interfaces and selected local_rules.py operations. No complete GugDove, Jiangshan or other homebrew engine.

capabilities.name: Other systems and older editions
capabilities.limits: BRP, older D&D, Pathfinder, Warhammer and other materials require source-specific edition and topic checks. Extraction is not rule verification.

capabilities.name: Optional corpus and handout processing
capabilities.limits: PDF, scan/OCR, CHM and old DOC adapters depend on available tools; card audit and recipient manifests. Full-text caches stay private.

capabilities.name: Historical creation and scene packs
capabilities.limits: Three reviewed example packs, six CoC7 builds and nine scenes; configured arithmetic does not establish historical truth or semantic clue sufficiency.

capabilities.name: Original rulebook and design lab
capabilities.limits: Explicit manifest dependencies, conflict repair and dream-game prototype. Undeclared prose contradictions and general balance are not automatically certified.

capabilities.name: Persistent session ledger
capabilities.limits: Atomic sourced events, revisions, replay, rollback and audience projection. Stores adjudicated outcomes, not complete action legality.

capabilities.name: Evidence dependency audit
capabilities.limits: AND/OR dependencies, unseeded cycles, missing evidence, bottlenecks and split knowledge. Declared logic only; not proof of fictional persuasiveness.

capabilities.name: Branch-aware recap and next preparation
capabilities.limits: Read-only current facts, active events, source revisions and explicit prep notes. No automatic inference of beliefs or triggering of GM plans.

capabilities.name: Local character registration
capabilities.limits: Persistent local numeric cards, aliases, atomic edits, export, actual CoC7 checks and retry-safe attribute batches. Age changes, derived values and full creation legality remain guided steps. Existing card-only databases stay separate from table databases.

capabilities.name: Local Dice and table services
capabilities.limits: Bounded expressions with raw dice, cards, teams, NPCs, initiative, private logs, exact note reminders, owner timers and attributed JSON decks. Topic help and Keeper table settings are local. Scripts, complete rule datasets and automatic character legality are outside this runtime.

capabilities.name: Conditional Keeper practice and recovery
capabilities.limits: 493 source bullets mapped to conditional procedures; eight synthetic situation walkthroughs with ledger recovery. Opinions are not RAW; no automatic diagnosis, complete rule verification or live-player certification.

capabilities.name: Recoverable action and Dice evidence workflow
capabilities.limits: Transactional intent, one-expression evidence, choices, reserved costs and atomic settlement; read-only .r/.rh bridge. Explicit adjudication; no complete legality engine or cross-database resource sync.

capabilities.name: Encounter boundaries and timed effects
capabilities.limits: Start/end boundaries, dynamic join/leave/order with per-round eligibility, configured refresh, explicit effect expiry/retiming and action holds. One encounter; no automatic legality, stacking, concentration or simultaneous turns.

capabilities.name: Structured campaign characters and stat snapshots
capabilities.limits: Private full and partial JSON update previews, atomic create/update, multilingual stat IDs, spent-capacity preservation, pending/combat guards and immutable action snapshots. Partial merges use one revision. No full creation/advancement legality, derived-stat automation or Dice card migration.

capabilities.name: Ledger-backed investigation knowledge and hypotheses
capabilities.limits: Explicit clue delivery/sharing, actor hypotheses/verdicts, dependency analysis, atomic acquisition and live append-only plan/route expansion. Only unseen observation text is editable. No automatic truth, deduction, communication legality or contradiction resolution.

capabilities.name: Exploration time, supplies and game-time reminders
capabilities.limits: Atomic explicit activity costs and minute advances, isolated previews, deadline barriers, pending rescheduling, anchored recurring reminders, validated receipts and private recovery. No automatic travel/rest rules, separate party clocks or wall-clock notifications.

capabilities.name: Consistent campaign backup and ledger checks
capabilities.limits: Exclusive SQLite backup including committed WAL, historical schema/event-hash/revision/profile checks and restore equality. No full event replay, authenticity proof, encryption, retention scheduler or cloud upload.

capabilities.name: Current local Dice database archives
capabilities.limits: Consistent exclusive Dice SQLite backup, basic state and per-scope receipt continuity checks, preserved cards/logs and no-reroll retry. No legacy dialect conversion, atomic campaign pairing, path rebinding or authenticity proof.
